games.name: [CUSTOMIZATION] Live of Life [DoD, but good?]
games.desc:
Ever played Die of Death? Well then you have probably heard of the joke Live of Life. Why be a joke when it could be real? 

Dont take this game seriously! If DoD is a joke game, then this is an even bigger joke. Even though the title says 'but good?' the game is supposed to be worse than Die Of Death.
Huge thanks to the DoD dev team for making such an inspiring game.

Thumbnail credits: Froggy, Paiiscary, meet_mark, epikgogy, galatcs

NOTE: This is not a 1:1 recreation of DoD. This game has been made from the ground up. Not a single asset is taken from Die Of Death. It does not aim to be an exact replicate of DoD, just heavily inspired by it! Specifically the late april state.
Important notice: Bildirmin is not a misspell, its a very important character.

games.name: PROJECT MONSTER
games.desc:

There are 2 game modes:
🤠You are a single player: You will play as a team
👹You are the monster: You must kill the other players

games.name: Survive Flight 871
games.desc:
Welcome to Survive Flight 871!

After your plane crash-lands in the remote, icy wilderness of Snow Mountain, you and the other survivors must navigate the harsh environment to stay alive. Resources are scarce, the weather is unforgiving, and the local wildlife, including dangerous polar bears, poses a constant threat.

Gather supplies, build shelters, and work together to find a way off the mountain. Do you have what it takes to survive the crash and make it back to safety?

Features:

➊Survival Mechanics: Manage your hunger, warmth, and water to stay alive.

➊Resource Gathering: Scavenge the wreckage and the environment for vital supplies.

➊Shelter Building: Construct shelters to protect yourself from the elements.

➊Wildlife Encounters: Beware of polar bears and other wildlife as you explore.

➊Teamwork: Collaborate with other players to increase your chances of survival.

Prepare for an intense and thrilling survival adventure in "Survive Flight 871"!

Please share plane crash
